title: The Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1970-07-30
source: MR(Abrams)>R@ 7.5 ips.(Peter Kafer)>R @ 7.5 ips.(Will Boswell) > CD; Transfered and mastered by Matt Smith 5/11; cd > flac dbpoweramp cd ripper

ai_review.summary: A thrilling Gospel‑era performance that’s unfortunately dulled by a noticeable hiss from multiple generations of transfer.
ai_review.review: The show captures the Dead at a high point – an intimate acoustic set with gospel numbers and a rare New Riders of the Purple Sage cameo featuring Garcia and Mickey Hart, which many reviewers cite as a favorite. However, the audio suffers from a persistent hiss that detracts from the listening experience, leading some to recommend alternative remasters.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers praise the musical performance but uniformly criticize the recording’s hiss; weighting the strong show (≈4.5) against poor audio quality (≈2.0) yields a mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High level of hiss introduced over many generations of transfer; noise and clutter noted, making the recording less clear than newer remasters.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short acoustic set that closes with gospel numbers (featuring David Nelson on mandolin) and includes a brief New Riders of the Purple Sage segment with Garcia and Mickey Hart.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is highlighted in the NRPS segment and praised as enjoyable.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart receives a nod for his work with the New Riders of the Purple Sage set.
